caption: Heritability of 16 autoimmune diseases partitioned across cis-regulatory elements of 57 cell types (S-LDSC); regulatory T cells lead for type 1 diabetes.
Variant-to-gene maps: SNP–gene pairs shared across, or unique to, cell types and traits.
3D-chromatin variant-to-gene links compared with eQTL resources, and the effector genes shared across autoimmune traits.
The FDFT1 locus: chromatin contacts link multiple sclerosis, rheumatoid arthritis and lupus variants to FDFT1, expressed in immune cells.
Lapaquistat, an FDFT1 inhibitor, shifts T-cell cytokines (TNF, IL-10, IL-17A, IL-21) in human tonsil organoids.
Bone-density heritability enrichment across 98 cell types, grouped by tissue (S-LDSC; red line = Bonferroni threshold).
The CRISPRi screen: target origins, test statistics and responsive genes, with loci where silencing changed ARID5B and NCOA3.
Chromatin accessibility and contact tracks at screened loci.
Putative childhood-obesity effector genes across cell types, including the ADCY3 locus.
An iPSC model of blood development profiled by single-nucleus multiome and Hi-C: stroma, endothelium, haemogenic endothelium and progenitors.
Chromatin compartments and loops that change along the endothelial-to-haematopoietic transition.
Blood-trait loci resolved in developing blood cells: PLEKHA7 (platelet count) and ATP2B1 (blood pressure).
Bayesian NMF groups sub-threshold sleep variants into four genetic profiles; chromatin data point one profile to EGR2.
Neuronal and glial RNAi screens in flies test the candidate sleep genes.
The BDNF locus: variants associated with opioid-use-disorder severity and the regulatory elements they contact.
A single-nucleus atlas of hepatoblastoma and adjacent liver: cell types and their composition across samples.
